correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the Haar rank-k projection and uses P^2=P to identify the normalized off-diagonal spherical row, B=P_ii~Beta(k/2,(n-k)/2), a beta-gamma product to isolate an independent shrink factor, and an independent-Gaussian conditioning argument for the baseline Student law. Moment and tail claims follow by explicit gamma integrals and bounded dominated convergence. Boundary cases k=1 (Cauchy, undefined expectation), k=2 (infinite MSE), k=n (exact), and zero offdiagonal row are handled; 15138 reproducible finite consistency assertions are supplementary, not proofs of infinite statements.
